business_problem: The group needed to support a very large water-service operation, but staff were limited, service coverage was inconsistent, knowledge quality varied across workers and customers could not get help around the clock.
solution_summary: Shenzhen Environment & Water Group and Baidu AI Cloud built the 'Shenxiaoshui' intelligent agent on top of Baidu's Qianfan platforms and the group's existing Shenshui Cloud Brain. The deployment is positioned as the country's first water-service agent and creates a three-sided service model for citizens, field water stewards and managers. On the citizen side, the agent simulates a human service representative and handles supply and drainage consultations 24x7. For field staff, it breaks through data silos across business systems so they can retrieve user consumption, work-order status and standardized response knowledge quickly. For managers, the agent aggregates service data, monitors performance indicators and supports a warning-dispatch-analysis-iteration loop that recommends service strategies and generates multidimensional analysis reports. All of this runs across a large operational footprint that includes hundreds of service workers, thousands of communities and millions of users, making the agent both a front-line service interface and an internal decision-support layer.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Packages the agent workflows used by citizens, water stewards and managers.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model development base behind the agent's understanding and analysis functions.

solution_components.name: Shenshui Cloud Brain
solution_components.role: Acts as the operational backbone that connects service data and business systems.

solution_components.name: Shenxiaoshui Agent
solution_components.role: Delivers always-on customer service, staff knowledge assistance and management decision support.

data_flow: Customer questions, user water-consumption records, work-order states and service metrics flow into Shenshui Cloud Brain and Qianfan-backed agent workflows; Shenxiaoshui then returns answers to citizens, knowledge and lookup results to stewards, and risk warnings and analysis reports to managers.
business_outcome: The utility created a 24x7 digital service layer that intercepts routine inquiries, improves staff consistency and gives managers a closed-loop view of service risk and resource allocation.
